name: Supported Image Swiper Formatter
description: A Swiper carousel formatter for Supported Image fields.
project_description:
Provides a Swiper formatter for Supported Image fields. Builds on the Swiper formatter project.

 Post-Installation 
 
 Go to the "Manage display" page of your entity type and change your supported image field's display formatter to "Swiper images". 
 Click the gear icon near the formatter to configure image output and swiper settings. 
 Save the display formatter settings. 
 
 Additional Requirements 
 
 Supported Image 
 Swiper formatter
